'**Legendary Olympia Specialization** / This counts as a Gold. / **Temper**' Warrior Equipment - Arms.

SHAPE COPIED VERBATIM from shipped hvy/aurum_aegis.json, whose printed text is word-for-word this card's ('Victor Specialization / This counts as a Gold / Temper') - only the specialization name differs - and from sibling .drafts/golden_galea.json (same family, same text shape). GRANT_SUBTYPE (effect_types.py:4381-4393) reads 'subtype' and appends 'Gold' to card.subtypes on equip, so gold-count and destroy-a-Gold cost checks see the equipment. ON_EQUIP is a mapped trigger (trigger_types.py:84).

TEMPER / LEGENDARY / SPECIALIZATION NOT AUTHORED: all three are in printed_keywords and fire from the card DB keywords field (Temper is an engine keyword mechanic, ability_keywords.temper); re-authoring them would be a defect.
